answer: Deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. Each agent burns 50 POA for one work slot lasting 20 epochs; one ripple of bad behaviour, a failed audit, burns the deposit and closes the slot. A forger wanting 1,000 slots pays 1,000 deposits, so the cost canyon between one honest agent and a sybil farm is 50,000 POA gone. Honest agents pay once, keep their terrace of work and earn it back in fees, so honesty is cheap while faking at scale is ruinous.
